banned_phrases.reason: Production readiness on real recordings is never claimed: every accuracy number is measured on a synthetic corpus (ADR 0024 decision G).
No claim that the strict profile contains a hostile decoder or provider unless SEC-T01 is resolved (decision E; L-068).
There is no multi-tenant host and SEC-T03 has not run (R0 must not advertise multi-tenant isolation).
The Windows and macOS executables are unsigned; the only trust signals are the checksum, the Sigstore attestation and npm provenance (decision C; L-098).
Durability is shown on Ubuntu 24.04 with local ext4 only (L-008, L-037).
Managed installation is qualified on Ubuntu 24.04 x64 only (ADR 0023 decision E).
Codex's Windows sandbox cannot run VSift (L-076, #204); the Codex trials ran in a Linux container.
Only the named models and clients were trialled; others are untested (L-082, L-084).
Compact-tier citation validity is not 100%: 2 of 62 phases missed on the #222 re-run.

The matrix cell (support-and-resource-profiles.md section 2) with its caveats; 'supported' is a statement about evidence, not a service promise. Carries 'Smart App Control untried' if RQ-17 was waived. The hosted evidence runs on Windows Server 2025, not Windows 11 (the project's Windows 11 machine ran the P08, P09 and P11 numbers and the Claude Code trials), and the document using this sentence must say so.

The matrix cell; durable sessions on local ext4 with barriers are a separate statement (CL-207). RQ-05 is read under its per-system rule (maintainer's decision of 2026-10-04): on this system the durable stage is covered by RQ-09 and RQ-12 where a hosted disk has no write barriers (L-113).

statements.text: macOS 15 on Apple silicon is supported on hosted-runner evidence only
statements.note: WORDING ACCEPTED by the maintainer on 2026-10-04, as proposed in P14 PR 9a (decision F left it to PR 9, replacing 'supported for what the hosted run proves'). RQ-05 is read under its per-system rule, decided the same day. The cell is the command line, a supplied transcript and local speech recognition with the user's own Homebrew tools, installed by npm, pnpm, Yarn, Bun or the archive, checked on hosted macOS 15 runners only: no managed install, no agent trial, Homebrew's builds not reviewed (L-114), Gatekeeper untried, and no Mac in the project's hands (L-035, L-098). The document using this sentence must say all of that beside it. Stays a qualification target, and this statement stays unused, if the candidate's runs of RQ-01, RQ-02, RQ-04 or RQ-05 do not pass.
